purpose: Compare ACIC Projections on road-usa-z and a similar-size mesh with one frozen baseline binary and layout.
prediction: If road's extra one-node cost is primarily lack of ready work, its idle share should exceed mesh24-z on the matched baseline. If it is coordination, road should instead show more threshold callbacks/rounds and longer callback delays. PE-time shares are not wall-time or causal fractions.
layout: 16 processes x 7 PEs on one exclusive cpu-interactive node
correctness: Each solve must pass the independent full-graph digest; tracing must cover solve only and must not flush its buffer.
scope: Single-source attribution, not a performance comparison across allocations or a new optimization.
